title: I-123-MIBG for Imaging of Neuroblastoma and Pheochromocytoma
brief_summary: I-123-MIBG is used to image patients with neuroblastoma, pheochromocytoma and other neural crest tumors
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically proven neuroblastoma or pheochromocytoma or strong suspicion of neuroblastoma or pheochromocytoma

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
study_population: Patients with histologically proven neuroblastoma or pheochromocytoma or strong suspicion of neuroblastoma or pheochromocytoma
